changelog: Universal Multi-Machine Injection & Admin Dependency Sync v0.1.6
features: Universal Machine Compatibility: Allowed UAC elevation services (svchost, consent) and NexVR launcher names
Elevated Dependency Synchronization: Automatically deploys onnxruntime, DirectML, and vrinject.json to protected Program Files directories
Real Exit Code Propagation: Propagates actual UAC injection exit codes to the launcher UI
Auto-resolving Copy Paths: Resolves executable directories automatically if CLI flags are omitted
fixes: Fixed Error 22 (Unauthorized caller) on tester machines with standard Windows UAC
Fixed silent injection failure in Sekiro caused by missing elevated permissions to write to Steam game directories
Fixed missing DirectML.dll and vrinject.json synchronization in game folder
